answer: Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical token: each agent must stake a unique quartz crystal whose signature is logged on-chain, and forging duplicates fails because the lattice fingerprint cannot be cloned. An attacker must acquire and register thousands of distinct crystals, a costly voyage through supply chains, while honest peers stake marble-sealed identities verified by random audit. Duplicate staking burns the stake, making mass forgery economically ruinous. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
